skills.definition: Builds communication practice through meaningful, caregiver-supported home activities.
skills.scopeBoundary: ABA at Home communication lessons may support functional communication, communication practice, imitation, and communication repair, but must not diagnose or treat articulation, phonological processes, fluency, voice, motor speech, or other speech-language disorders. Speech, AAC, sign, gesture, pictures, showing, pointing, and established combinations are valid; communication tools remain available and spoken responses are not universally required.
skills.communicationSafeguard: ABA at Home communication lessons may support functional communication, communication practice, imitation, and communication repair, but must not diagnose or treat articulation, phonological processes, fluency, voice, motor speech, or other speech-language disorders. Speech, AAC, sign, gesture, pictures, showing, pointing, and established combinations are valid; communication tools remain available and spoken responses are not universally required.
